prompts.amber: Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality desktop UI with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, purposeful spacing. Product: Classic AI Launcher. Input image is the user's actual 2013 DDE Classic Launcher screenshot; use as visual grounding, not as an edit target. Target dimensions 1440 x 1080, same 4:3 aspect ratio as 600 x 450 reference, naturally recomposed without stretching. Full-screen desktop launcher surface, no device, browser chrome, presentation slide, or marketing text. Preserve reference core: strongly blurred photographic wallpaper, translucent understated LEFT category rail, TOP centered unified search, CENTRAL dense 6-column colorful slightly dimensional app-icon grid, small labels, light borders and minimal card boundaries. The layout must feel like a desktop launcher, compact and readable, not a dashboard. Match the source's spatial organization. Body labels 15-17px at target scale. Chinese UI with actual English application names. Left categories: 全部, 网络, 多媒体, 游戏, 图形, 办公, 开发, 系统, 工具, AI. Selected category subtle translucent rectangular strip, no oversized pills. Apps can include Firefox, Chromium, Files, Terminal, VS Code, Zed, LibreOffice, VLC, GIMP, Krita, Blender, OBS Studio, Inkscape, Git, Calculator, Settings, Calendar, Notes, XConnect, Archive Manager, System Monitor, Text Editor, Image Viewer, AI Tasks. Consistent 56px colorful authentic recognizable icons, no tiles around every app. This product targets macOS 26, Linux GNOME 50, KDE Plasma 6.6, DDE 7.0, Xfce with one desktop-independent core and platform adapters; these are architecture constraints, do not print compatibility charts or implementation jargon on screen. Do not depend on or show DDE suite, Deepin Store, Linglong, Deepin AI. Do not embed a custom dock: omit reference dock from launcher-owned content. Unified input supports application search, system actions, natural-language Agent commands. Only show a focused use case, one primary action and one or two supporting areas, not a feature inventory. Group with alignment, spacing, thin dividers and subtle tint. No cards inside cards, no giant rounding, no gratuitous badges/metrics, no chat bubbles, no permanent chatbot sidebar. No date/time needed. Three directions will be generated independently; this image must contain ONE single screen only. Direction name: 经典琥珀 / Amber Classic. Highest visual fidelity to 2013 reference. Warm cream, amber and subtle charcoal blurred architectural wallpaper, bright on left and darker right; sufficient translucent brown shade for readable white labels with restrained text shadows. All selected. Make app browsing the hero: 6 columns x 5 rows in center/right with compact spacing, category rail 190px wide. At top a 720px-wide low 40px-high search field, nearly square corners, placeholder "搜索应用、系统操作，或描述任务…" with small search glyph left and subtle AI affordance right. Below search a single fine muted hint line "试试：Firefox · 调低音量 · 整理下载文件夹". No results panel because this is idle browsing. Focus VS Code with a faint rectangular highlight. At bottom small keyboard legend "输入即搜索    ↑↓←→ 选择    Enter 打开    Esc 关闭". Tiny product wordmark Classic AI Launcher at upper-left. The AI integration must be understated and search-native. Deliver crisp premium desktop screenshot, no title outside UI.
